group: Heading of the sidebar's list of rooms. "Room" is a product noun: one conversation several people and a socio (AI agent) share.
room: Accessible name of a room's icon (speech bubbles). "Room" is a product noun.
new-room: Accessible name and tooltip of the + button beside the sidebar's Rooms heading; it opens the dialog that creates a room.
invitations: Sidebar row that opens the room invitations waiting for the reader.
invitations-waiting: Said by screen readers right after "Invitations" (the badge beside it is hidden from them): how many invitations wait. Starts with a comma because it continues that word.
empty: Note in the sidebar while the reader is in no room. "socio" is the product's word for an AI agent.
show-fewer: Sidebar button that folds the rooms list back to the most recent ones.
show-all: Sidebar button that lists every room; count is how many rooms there are.
muted: Said by screen readers after a room's title when the reader muted it (a crossed bell shows). Starts with a comma because it continues the title.
unread: Said by screen readers after a room's title: unread is how many messages are new there, already formatted (for example "3" or "99+"). Starts with a comma because it continues the title.
admin: Small tag on a sidebar room row when the reader is one of that room's admins.
options-for: Accessible name of the ⋯ button on a sidebar room row; title is the room's name.
invites.one: Notice on Home when one room invitation waits; title is the room's name.
invites.many: Notice on Home when several room invitations wait; count is how many.
invites.review: Button in the Home notice that opens the invitations.
menu.section: Label over the room's items in the phone header's ⋯ menu.
menu.members: Menu item: opens the room's Members panel (its people and socios).
menu.topic: Menu item: opens the room's Telegram topic settings (a Telegram group topic linked to the room).
menu.rename: Item in a room's ⋯ menu, for room admins: opens the Rename room dialog.
menu.archive: Item in a room's ⋯ menu, for room admins: archives the room, making it read-only.
menu.unarchive: Item in an archived room's ⋯ menu, for room admins: brings the room back.
menu.leave: Destructive menu item: the reader leaves the room.
menu.notify: Label over the menu's choices of what in this room notifies the reader (everything, mentions, nothing).
toasts.archived: Toast after a room was archived; it has an Undo button.
toasts.undo: Button in the "Room archived" toast; it unarchives the room again.
toasts.unarchived: Toast after a room was unarchived.
errors.read: Toast when the room's people couldn't be read before the Leave dialog opens.
